testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel closing a modified unsaved part: tmp/obk-3948-scenarios/features/application/document-saving/document-saving.feature:83:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel closing a modified unsaved part ✔ Given an unsaved part containing a finished empty sketch is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And save-change prompts are configured to always show ✔ When the user closes the document tab ✔ Then a save-changes prompt offers Yes, No and Cancel ✔ When the user chooses Cancel ✔ Then the part remains active ✔ And its sketch remains in the model browser

testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel the first save requested while closing a part: tmp/obk-3948-scenarios/features/application/document-saving/document-saving.feature:92:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel the first save requested while closing a part ✔ Given an unsaved part containing a finished empty sketch is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And save-change prompts are configured to always show ✔ When the user closes the document tab ✔ And the user chooses Yes in the save-changes prompt ✔ Then the Save As dialog opens ✔ When the user cancels Save As ✔ Then the part remains active ✔ And its sketch remains in the model browser

testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel disabling the preview picture: tmp/obk-3948-scenarios/features/application/document-saving/document-saving.feature:170:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel disabling the preview picture ✔ Given the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software ✔ And Save Preview Picture is selected ✔ When the user clears Save Preview Picture ✔ And the user cancels the dialog ✔ And the user presses Control+S again for the same part ✔ Then Save Preview Picture is selected ✔ And the preview source choices are displayed

testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel a change to the preview source: tmp/obk-3948-scenarios/features/application/document-saving/document-saving.feature:179:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel a change to the preview source ✔ Given the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software ✔ And Save Preview Picture is selected ✔ And Active Component Iso View on Save is selected ✔ When the user chooses Active Window on Save ✔ And the user cancels the dialog ✔ And the user presses Control+S again for the same part ✔ Then Active Component Iso View on Save is selected ✔ And Active Window on Save is not selected
